top_signals.title: Innolight Prices $6.8 Billion Hong Kong Listing Below Maximum
top_signals.summary: Zhongji Innolight Co. raised HK$53.4 billion ($6.8 billion) after pricing its Hong Kong listing below the maximum offered in one of the city’s biggest first-time share sale in seven years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
